metadata.purpose: Forward values whose selected key is not in the Set of ANY previously forwarded keys since the last flush.

conditions: At most one original value is forwarded per source value; no key is replayed or emitted.
Set membership is SameValueZero, unlike the default strict comparator of distinctUntilChanged.
Optional flush.next clears history. Source completion/error/cancellation ends output independently.

scope.parameters: selected=false, withFlushes=true. Full Set for finite trace prefixes.
scope.callbacks: An optional keySelector is modeled by an external correlated key.return/key.throw; no user callback runs in guards. Without it, key is the original value and membership is checked directly.
scope.time: No scheduling or clock. Flush and source timestamps/order come from external deliveries; equal-time tie order is explicit.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant source, notifier and observers; post-setup notifier subscription after source subscription.
exclusions: Arbitrary nested deliveries, source completion during synchronous notifier wiring, and throwing observers/finalizers.
Unbounded keys for infinite sources, safe-integer overflow, generalized ObservableInput flush conversions, and production effect interpretation.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe to source; optionally subscribe to flushes after source connection in this non-reentrant post-setup profile.

ownership.sharing: No sharing introduced; each subscription owns its own Set and notifier subscription.
ownership.reset: Flush next clears Set, notifier completion retains Set, source termination closes the execution.

dispatch.actionSemantics: The set stores opaque key references; no cloning or hashing of payload content. Selector phases resolve before later source/notifier delivery.
cancellationCheckpoints: After a complete value reaction; release both live subscriptions without notifying downstream.

inputs.description: flush notifier emits a value and resets the key Set
flush notifier completes without resetting or ending result

controls.description: source live; key Set retained; notifier may be active

actions: subscribe flush notifier if configured; source first
rules.nextState: active with empty Set and optional flush subscription
rules.explanation: Each result subscription begins with its own empty set. When a flush notifier is supplied, source subscription happens before notifier subscription in the scoped post-setup trace.

rules.guard: selector configured and index is valid
actions: request a correlated key selection with the original value
rules.nextState: selecting a key with existing Set retained
rules.explanation: When a user keySelector is provided, invoke it for EVERY source value, even values ultimately discarded. This operation is synchronous; thrown selectors are terminal.

rules.guard: no key selector and Set does not contain incoming value under SameValueZero
actions: add original value to Set before forwarding it
rules.explanation: Without a keySelector, distinct compares source values using Set membership. A previously unseen value is added before forwarding the ORIGINAL value; NaN equals NaN in a Set.

rules.guard: no key selector and Set already contains incoming value under SameValueZero
rules.nextState: active with unchanged Set and increased index
rules.explanation: Any repeated key is dropped, even if other values occurred in between. Only flush notifications can clear historical Set membership.

rules.guard: matching selection and previously unseen key under SameValueZero
actions: add selected key then forward original source value
rules.explanation: A selector result absent from the Set is remembered, and the original source value (not the key) is forwarded unchanged.

rules.guard: matching selection and previously seen key under SameValueZero
rules.explanation: A selected key already in the Set suppresses the source value. It does not replace or delete any remembered key.
A throwing keySelector ends the stream immediately. The original input is not forwarded and both owned subscriptions are released.

actions: clear the Set without forwarding the flush value
rules.explanation: Each flush notifier next clears the entire remembered key set. It does not produce a downstream next or complete notification.

actions: release notifier subscription without completing downstream or clearing the Set
rules.nextState: active, with the existing Set but no future flush events
rules.explanation: Flush notifier completion is ignored as a downstream lifecycle event. Existing keys remain; the notifier subscription closes.
A flush notifier error propagates downstream, immediately tearing down the source and notifier. It is not treated as a harmless reset.

actions: complete result; release source and active notifier
rules.explanation: When the source completes, distinct does not emit its Set. It completes and releases any still-active flush subscription.

actions: forward exact source error; release source and active notifier
rules.explanation: Source errors terminate without clearing or emitting the remembered Set. The source and notifier are released.

actions: release source and active notifier without downstream completion
rules.explanation: Downstream unsubscription releases both owned subscriptions. Cancellation is not a completion event.
